question: Which of the following cities will be the host of Summer Olympics 2028?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Los Angeles.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Session of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) meeting in Lima, Peru, elected Paris as the host city of the Games of the XX**XIII Olympiad 2024 and Los Angeles **as the host city of the Games of the** XXXIV Olympiad 2028.**
 
• The 2028 Summer Olympic and Paralympic Games will be hosted in Los Angeles, United States.
 
• The opening ceremony for the** 2028 Los Angeles **Olympics will take place on July 14, 2028, and continue till July 30.
 
• Los Angeles was elected as the host city for the 2028 Summer Olympics at the 131st IOC Session in Lima, Peru on September 13, 2017. 
 
• Paris and Los Angeles were officially awarded the Games at the **131st IOC Session in Lima, Peru, on 13 September 2017.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IOC to host the upcoming Olympic Games:- **

 
 
• **Paris:- ** 2024 Summer Olympics,
 
• **Milan–Cortina d'Ampezzo:- **2026 Winter Olympics
 
• **Brisbane:-** 2032 Summer Olympics.
 
• **Los Angeles:-** 2028 Summer Olympics,
